say:0:1720930001:1.text: The tavern is loud with minstrel songs, drunken boasting, and the clatter of cups. Everything looks perfectly normal at the first glance.
say:0:1720930001:1.source_cn: 酒馆内人声鼎沸，吟游诗人的歌声、酒客的吹牛声和酒杯碰撞...

say:1:1720930002:1.text: You carefully watch every corner of the tavern, especially the kitchen pass where food and empty dishes keep moving in and out, but there is no sign of any newspapers.
say:1:1720930002:1.source_cn: 你仔细观察着酒馆的每一个角落，特别是那个不断有食物和空...
say:1:1720930002:1.male: You carefully watch every corner of the tavern, especially the kitchen pass where food and empty dishes keep moving in and out, but there is no sign of any newspapers.
say:1:1720930002:1.female: You carefully watch every corner of the tavern, especially the kitchen pass where food and empty dishes keep moving in and out, but there is no sign of any newspapers.

say:3:1720930003:1.text: What can I get you folks? Our wheat brew is the best in all of Savannah!
say:3:1720930003:1.source_cn: 几位，喝点什么？我这儿的麦酒可是全赛凡纳最够味儿的。

say:5:1720930004:1.text: We're not here for drinks. We're here to pick up... something special.
say:5:1720930004:1.source_cn: 老板，我们不喝酒。我们是来……取点“特别的货”。

say:6:1720930005:1.text: Just to be clear, I'm only a waiter. If you're asking about drinks, everything we serve is on the menu. There's no secret list, nothing off-menu, and nothing here called "something special."
say:6:1720930005:1.source_cn: 呃……首先呢，我不是老板。其次，所有酒的种类都写在酒单...

say:7:1720930006:1.text: If you're not ordering, I need to get to the next table.
say:7:1720930006:1.source_cn: 没想好喝什么的话，不如让后面的客人先点？

say:9:1720930007:1.text: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.
say:9:1720930007:1.male: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.
say:9:1720930007:1.female: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.

choice_prompt:10:1720930007.text: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.
choice_prompt:10:1720930007.source_cn: 侦探<male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>，这里看起来……好像和《赛凡纳之眼》没什么关系啊。
choice_prompt:10:1720930007.male: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.
choice_prompt:10:1720930007.female: Detective... this place really doesn't look like it has anything to do with the Savannah Eye.

say:11:1720930008:1.text: The newsboy said the papers show up here by dawn. So whoever drops them off must be coming at night. Do we come back later, or stay and wait?
say:11:1720930008:1.source_cn: 我记得报童说过，每天清晨出餐口会出现报纸，看来对方大概...

choice_prompt:12:1720930008.text: The newsboy said the papers show up here by dawn. So whoever drops them off must be coming at night. Do we come back later, or stay and wait?
choice_prompt:12:1720930008.source_cn: 我记得报童说过，每天清晨出餐口会出现报纸，看来对方大概率是在晚上行动。那我们要等到晚上再来吗？还是在这里一直等着？

say:13:1720930009:1.text: Now that's real detective work. Alright, we'll wait outside and see what they're up to!
say:13:1720930009:1.source_cn: 高明！我们就守在外面，看看他们耍什么花招！

choice:12:0:1.text: We step outside and watch the place from nearby.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 先离开酒馆，在附近观察吧
choice:12:0:1.male: We step outside and watch the place from nearby.
choice:12:0:1.female: We step outside and watch the place from nearby.

choice:12:1:2.text: We go somewhere quiet, with a clear view of the entrance.
choice:12:1:2.male: We go somewhere quiet, with a clear view of the entrance.
choice:12:1:2.female: We go somewhere quiet, with a clear view of the entrance.

choice:10:0:1.text: There are too many people around.
choice:10:0:1.male: There are too many people around.
choice:10:0:1.female: There are too many people around.
